tile.create_icbm:launcherbase.tooltip.su: Holds a _missile_ upright and launches it. Needs _Rotational Force_ from a shaft on the side facing away from the missile.
tile.create_icbm:launcherbase.tooltip.be: _Winds up_ the launch charge. At 64 RPM it is full in about _4 seconds_; a missile only leaves the pad on a _full_ charge.
Launches at the target set in a linked _Launch Controller_, or the target sent by radio.
tile.create_icbm:launcherbase.tooltip.ac: Opens the pad's settings: lock height, group and firing delay.
The firing panel for every _Launch Pad_ linked to it through _gantries_ and _connectors_. Needs no rotation of its own.
Every ready pad in the chosen group _launches_ at the target.
_Copies_ the stored coordinates in as the target.
Opens the controller: target, group, radio channel and the _Launch_ button.
tile.create_icbm:launcherframe.tooltip.s: A girder that stands next to a missile on its pad. It also carries the _launch network_ between pads and controllers.
tile.create_icbm:launcher_connector.tool: Carries the _launch network_ between pads, gantries and controllers, like a cable laid along the floor.
A rotating turret that aims a missile and fires it straight at its target. Needs _Rotational Force_ from a shaft below.
_Turns_ the turret towards the target, faster at higher speed, and _winds up_ the launch charge.
Launches once it is _on target_ and fully wound.
_Copies_ the stored coordinates in as the target.
Opens the turret: target, radio channel and the missile slot.
tile.create_icbm:radarstation.tooltip.su: A spinning dish that tracks _missiles_ in flight. Needs _Rotational Force_ of at least _16 RPM_ from a shaft below.
tile.create_icbm:radarstation.tooltip.be: _Scans_ the sky within its detection range and raises the alarm when a missile heads into its trigger range.
Emits a _redstone signal_, if enabled, and sends an alert on its radio channel.
tile.create_icbm:radarstation.tooltip.ac: Opens the radar: ranges, radio channel and the radar screen.
tile.create_icbm:emptower.0.tooltip.summ: A coil that turns _Rotational Force_ into an _electromagnetic pulse_. Needs a shaft below.
tile.create_icbm:emptower.0.tooltip.beha: _Charges_ the coil. Faster shafts charge it quicker.
Releases an _EMP_ that wipes power from machines and disables missiles in its radius, then cools down.
tile.create_icbm:emptower.0.tooltip.acti: Opens the tower: blast radius, radio channel and the _Fire_ button.
tile.create_icbm:emptower.1.tooltip.summ: Stacks on top of an _EMP Tower_ to extend its maximum blast radius.
tile.create_icbm:radioactive.0.tooltip.s: Fallout left behind by a nuclear blast. _Irradiates_ whoever stands on it.
tile.create_icbm:radioactive.1.tooltip.s: Fallout left behind by a nuclear blast. _Irradiates_ whoever stands on it.
A missile that hunts _flying targets_, other missiles included. Fire it from a _Cruise Turret_ or a handheld launcher.
A pressed sheet-metal _rocket body_. Turn it into a _Missile Module_ at a Crafting Table or a _Mechanical Crafter_.
item.create_icbm:radarGun.tooltip.summar: Measures the _coordinates_ of whatever block you aim at and stores them.
item.create_icbm:radarGun.tooltip.behavi: _Copies_ the stored target into a Launch Controller or Cruise Turret.
item.create_icbm:radarGun.tooltip.action: _Scans_ the block you are aiming at.
item.create_icbm:remoteDetonator.tooltip: Sends a _radio signal_ on its channel to set off _wired crates_, launch linked missiles and fire EMP Towers.
_Tunes_ to the channel of a Launch Controller, Cruise Turret or EMP Tower.
Paints a target with a laser and _radios_ it to launchers on the same channel.
_Marks_ the block you aim at and calls the strike.
A shoulder launcher that fires a missile in a _straight line_ where you aim.
item.create_icbm:ballisticLauncher.toolt: A shoulder launcher that lobs a missile in a _high arc_ onto where you aim.
item.create_icbm:poisonPowder.tooltip.su: A toxic powder used in _chemical_ and _contagious_ explosives.
item.create_icbm:antidote.tooltip.summar: _Cures_ every effect when drunk, toxins and radiation included.
explosive.tooltip.behaviour1: Detonates after a short fuse. _Redstone_, _fire_ and the _Remote Detonator_ all set it off.
explosive.tooltip.action1: _Wires_ the crate to the detonator's channel. That detonator then sets it off from any distance.
missile.tooltip.behaviour1: Flies to its target from a _Launch Pad_, a _Cruise Turret_ or a handheld launcher.
bombcart.tooltip.condition1: When Powered by an Activator Rail
bombcart.tooltip.behaviour2: Goes off at once if it was moving, burning or caught in a blast.
explosive.create_icbm:condensed.effect.s: A _stronger TNT blast_ that reaches about _half again as far_ as TNT, breaking blocks and hurting anything close by.
explosive.create_icbm:shrapnel.effect.su: Sprays hundreds of _burning metal shards_ in every direction. They _set targets alight_ but leave blocks untouched.
Scatters _fire_ over a wide area, thickest near the center, and _clears away ice_. The blast itself breaks no blocks.
explosive.create_icbm:debilitation.effec: Releases a _white gas cloud_ that lingers for _30 seconds_. Solid walls keep it out.
You are _poisoned_, heavily _slowed_ and get _mining fatigue_ that lasts a minute after you leave.
explosive.create_icbm:chemical.effect.su: Releases a _yellow toxic cloud_ that lingers for _30 seconds_. Solid walls keep it out.
explosive.create_icbm:chemical.effect.be: You are _poisoned_, nauseous, hungry and weak. After about 5 seconds the gas also deals _damage_ that keeps growing the longer you stay.
explosive.create_icbm:anvil.effect.summa: Hurls hundreds of _heavy anvil chunks_ in every direction, each hitting about _three times harder_ than shrapnel. Blocks are left untouched.
explosive.create_icbm:repulsive.effect.s: A small blast that _throws back_ every mob, player and item within _12 blocks_. The closer you are, the harder you fly.
A small blast that _pulls in_ every mob, player and item within _12 blocks_. The farther away you are, the harder the pull.
explosive.create_icbm:colors.effect.summ: Releases a harmless cloud of _rainbow-colored gas_ that lingers for _30 seconds_. It breaks nothing and hurts no one.
explosive.create_icbm:smoke.effect.summa: Puffs out a column of _smoke_ for 5 seconds. Harmless, so it is handy for _marking a target_ or testing your aim.
explosive.create_icbm:fragmentation.effe: Scatters over 200 _explosive fragments_ in every direction. Each one _blows up_ where it lands, pitting the ground all around.
Releases a _green viral cloud_ that lingers for _30 seconds_. Solid walls keep it out.
You get _severe poison_, _blindness_, hunger and weakness. After a couple of seconds it also deals _damage_ that keeps growing the longer you stay.
Turns pigs into _zombified piglins_ and villagers into _zombie villagers_.
explosive.create_icbm:sonic.effect.summa: Sends an expanding _shockwave_ out to about _15 blocks_ that rips up blocks and _flings_ mobs and players into the air.
explosive.create_icbm:sonic.effect.behav: _Sets off_ any explosive crates in its path.
explosive.create_icbm:breaching.effect.s: Punches a _3x3 tunnel_ up to _7 blocks deep_ in one direction, cutting through even obsidian. Unbreakable blocks stop it.
explosive.create_icbm:breaching.effect.b: Goes off _instantly_ when triggered and blasts _into the block_ it was placed against.
explosive.create_icbm:breaching.effect.c: On a Missile or Bomb Cart
explosive.create_icbm:breaching.effect.b: Always drills _straight down_ from where it goes off.
explosive.create_icbm:thermobaric.effect: Wipes out terrain within about _30 blocks_ and kills anything caught _in the open_ within 50. Destroyed blocks drop nothing.
explosive.create_icbm:nuclear.effect.sum: Wipes out terrain within about _50 blocks_ and kills anything caught _in the open_ in that range. Destroyed blocks drop nothing.
explosive.create_icbm:nuclear.effect.beh: Out to 80 blocks, plants and leaves are stripped away, patches of stone and dirt turn into _radioactive fallout_, and pigs and villagers turn into _zombies_.
explosive.create_icbm:emp.effect.summary: Releases an _electromagnetic pulse_ that _drains stored energy_ from machines, batteries and carried items within _50 blocks_. Breaks no blocks.
explosive.create_icbm:emp.effect.behavio: Each one caught may _blow up_, lose guidance and fall, or set off its own warhead.
Creepers become _charged_ and lit explosive crates _fizzle out_.
A beam of _heat_ that turns the land within about _30 blocks_ into _netherrack, magma and lava_, boils away water and sets everything ablaze.
explosive.create_icbm:endothermic.effect: A beam of _cold_ that freezes the land within about _30 blocks_: water and ground turn to _ice and snow_, lava to obsidian, and fires go out.
Mobs within 30 blocks are left _badly slowed_ and poisoned, and the time turns to _morning_.
For 2 minutes, peels blocks off the ground within about _30 blocks_ and sends them _floating_ skyward, lifting mobs and players too.
Gravity returns and everything still in the air _comes crashing down_.
explosive.create_icbm:ender.effect.summa: Opens an _ender vortex_ for 8 seconds that drags in everything within _20 blocks_ and _teleports_ whatever reaches the center.
explosive.create_icbm:ender.effect.behav: Everything caught lands together at a _random spot_ up to 150 blocks away.
explosive.create_icbm:flashbang.effect.s: A blinding _white flash_ fills the screen of every player within _16 blocks_ for a second, with a deafening bang. Breaks nothing and hurts no one.
explosive.create_icbm:recon.effect.summa: Sends out a _radar pulse_ that makes every mob and enemy player within _32 blocks_ _glow_, visible through walls, for _3 minutes_. Breaks nothing.
explosive.create_icbm:recon.effect.behav: Everyone except the player who launched or lit it, their _team_ and their _tamed pets_.
explosive.create_icbm:phantom.effect.sum: Conjures _fake mobs_ around every player within _24 blocks_. They close in and swing at you, but _never deal any damage_.
explosive.create_icbm:phantom.effect.beh: It _vanishes_ in a puff of smoke. Phantoms nobody hits fade away on their own after a minute.
explosive.create_icbm:darkness.effect.su: Gives every player and mob within _24 blocks_ the _Darkness_ effect for _3 minutes_. Breaks nothing.
_Erases everything_ within _55 blocks_, even bedrock, and kills anything caught _in the open_ within 110. Nothing is left to drop.
Destroys every _red matter_ black hole within about 220 blocks instead, leaving the terrain intact.
explosive.create_icbm:redmatter.effect.s: Spawns a _black hole_ that devours the blocks around it, growing as it feeds, and _drags in_ anything nearby to be crushed.
explosive.create_icbm:redmatter.effect.b: Grows a block at a time up to a _70-block radius_, and its pull reaches twice as far.
An _antimatter_ blast within about 220 blocks destroys it.
missile.create_icbm:missile.tooltip.summ: A missile with _no warhead_ yet. Combine it with an _explosive crate_ at a Crafting Table, or deploy the crate onto it with a _Deployer_, to arm it with that explosive.
missile.create_icbm:missile.tooltip.beha: Goes off with a _small blast_, a little weaker than TNT.
jei.create_icbm.info.radioactive: Radioactive Dirt and Stone have no recipe. They are the fallout a Nuclear blast leaves behind, and they irradiate anyone standing on them.
jei.create_icbm.info.missile_module: The Missile Module is a missile with no warhead. Combine it with an explosive crate at a Crafting Table, or arm it on a Depot with a Deployer holding the crate: the crate's type becomes the warhead. Bomb Carts are made the same way from a Minecart.
item.create_icbm:delivery_missile.empty: Empty. Shift + right-click it in hand to open its cargo slot.
item.create_icbm:delivery_missile.toolti: Carries _one stack_ of items, anything a chest slot can hold (shulker boxes too), to its target.
Puts the stack _into the container_ it hits, like a chest, barrel or vault. Anywhere else it is left in a _Mail parcel_ with the sender's name on it. Does no damage.
_Loads_ the stack straight from your inventory. R-Click it with an empty hand to take the stack back out.
jei.create_icbm.info.delivery_missile: Shift + right-click the Delivery Missile in your hand to open its cargo slot, or right-click a stack onto it in your inventory like a bundle. It carries one stack of anything a chest slot holds. Launch it at a chest, barrel, vault or other container and the stack goes inside. Anywhere else it arrives as a Mail parcel labelled with the sender's name: right-click the parcel to take the items, and it disappears once it is empty.
info.create_icbm:mail.collected_partial: Collected %s x %s from %s, your inventory is full
create_icbm.ponder.launch_pad.header: Launching Missiles from a Launch Pad
create_icbm.ponder.launch_pad.text_1: Launch Pads hold a missile ready for launch
create_icbm.ponder.launch_pad.text_2: They take Rotational Force on the side facing away from the missile
create_icbm.ponder.launch_pad.text_3: Rotation winds up the launch charge. At 64 RPM a pad is fully wound in about 4 seconds
create_icbm.ponder.launch_pad.text_4: A missile only leaves the pad on a full charge, so a stopped or overstressed network holds it back
create_icbm.ponder.launch_pad.text_5: Link pads to a Launch Controller through Launch Gantries or Connectors
create_icbm.ponder.launch_pad.text_6: Set a target in the controller and fire every ready pad in the group
create_icbm.ponder.cruise_turret.header: Aiming and Firing a Cruise Turret
create_icbm.ponder.cruise_turret.text_1: Cruise Turrets aim a missile and fire it straight at their target
create_icbm.ponder.cruise_turret.text_2: A shaft from below turns the turret and winds up its launch charge
create_icbm.ponder.cruise_turret.text_3: Faster shafts aim faster: 32 RPM turns at normal speed, 128 RPM four times as fast
create_icbm.ponder.cruise_turret.text_4: Hand it a target with a Laser Range Finder, or type one into its menu
create_icbm.ponder.cruise_turret.text_5: Once it is on target and fully wound, a radio signal or the menu fires the missile
create_icbm.ponder.radar_station.header: Tracking Missiles with a Radar Station
create_icbm.ponder.radar_station.text_1: Radar Stations track missiles in flight
create_icbm.ponder.radar_station.text_2: The dish needs at least 16 RPM from below. Slower than that, it stays dark
create_icbm.ponder.radar_station.text_3: Once it spins fast enough, it scans the sky within its detection range
create_icbm.ponder.radar_station.text_4: Right-click it with Redstone to switch on its redstone output
create_icbm.ponder.radar_station.text_5: A missile heading into its trigger range now raises a redstone signal, and an alert on its radio channel
create_icbm.ponder.emp_tower.header: Firing Electromagnetic Pulses from an EMP Tower
create_icbm.ponder.emp_tower.text_1: EMP Towers turn Rotational Force into an electromagnetic pulse
create_icbm.ponder.emp_tower.text_2: A shaft from below charges the coil. Faster shafts charge it quicker
create_icbm.ponder.emp_tower.text_3: Stack Coil Extenders on top to grow the largest blast radius it can fire
create_icbm.ponder.emp_tower.text_4: Pick a radius and fire it from the menu or by radio. The pulse drains stored power and knocks missiles out of the sky
create_icbm.ponder.emp_tower.text_5: Engineer's Goggles show the coil charge and the cooldown after each shot
create_icbm.ponder.arming.text_1: A Missile Module starts out without a warhead
create_icbm.ponder.arming.text_2: A Deployer two blocks above the Depot fits the warhead
create_icbm.ponder.arming.text_3: Give it an explosive crate. The type of crate decides what the warhead does
create_icbm.ponder.arming.text_4: The missile is armed, ready for a Launch Pad or Cruise Turret
create_icbm.ponder.arming.text_5: A Minecart becomes a Bomb Cart the same way
create_icbm.ponder.arming.text_6: Both can also be made at a Crafting Table by combining the explosive crate with a Missile Module or a Minecart
